accounts.name: seller_fee_agreement
docs: Shared supplier-approved lifetime capacity; omitted only when this Tab cannot charge a fee.

instructions.name: accept_metered_tab
docs: Buyer credential and issuer sign the full quantity × unit-price policy through accepted Tab terms.

instructions.name: capture_completed_run
docs: The accepted supplier attests one completed run and its measured quantity.

accounts.name: refund_custody
docs: repayment receipt; may alias the typed source or unchecked creditor.

accounts.name: refund_custody
docs: from the immutable repayment receipt; absent for ordinary owner cash.

accounts.name: supplier_principal
docs: Current supplier principal authenticates surrender; payment route is unchanged.

instructions.name: release_unused
docs: Only the supplier can surrender an accepted unused promise before its
capture deadline. After expiry anyone can release the unused remainder;
earned supplier payable and debt are never canceled by this operation.

instructions.name: repay
docs: Repayment reduces buyer debt and transfers to the recorded creditor
treasury. It never calls Registry to replenish expenditure permission.

accounts.name: repayment_authority
docs: The token owner authorizes repayment independently of the rent/fee sponsor.
A governed wallet may provide this signature through its native CPI.

fields.name: provenance_hash
docs: Signed ownership/provenance attestation; not proof adjudicating third-party title.

fields.name: consumed
docs: Lifetime expenditure; repayment has no Registry entrypoint.

fields.name: revision
docs: Positive revision of the owner-approved allowance policy.

types.name: CollectionCorrectionUsage
docs: Cumulative use of one authenticated original collection receipt. A new
request ID, later payment, rotation or refund cannot reset this allowance.

types.name: CompletedRunOrigin
docs: One immutable, supplier-attested bill per supplier, billing namespace and run.

types.name: CompletedRunPayment
docs: Resolves the submitted financial ID to the original bill and its sole financial effect.

fields.name: request_id
docs: Caller-owned raw ID; the permanent receipt ID is scoped to owner signer.

types.name: CorrectionAmounts
docs: Gross, monotonic facts for one run or a correctly aggregated claim.
`principal_credited` is this lifecycle's part of the more general
PrincipalAmounts.extinguished counter. A prior principal payment stays in
`repaid` when its actual payer later receives a correction refund.

types.name: CorrectionPlan
docs: Agreed allocation for one atomic bill correction. The original supplier's
collected portion is applied to current debt first. Explicit compensation
can make the remaining noncash creditor reduction whole; it creates no new
debt or implicit reimbursement right for the consenting cash funder.

fields.name: backing_released_from_payable
docs: Earned payable backing made free; this does not release unearned work.

types.name: CorrectionReceipt
docs: Fixed-size immutable result supplements the unchanged financial-journal ABI.
The journal commits this account's address; this result commits its effect
hash. Neither record requires rewriting an original capture or payment.

fields.name: allocated_fee_caps
docs: Lifetime cap allocation is distinct from outstanding risk usage.

types.name: FeeFailurePolicy
docs: A missing/frozen canonical fee destination, or actual balance below its Core
accounted cash, waives this deduction and leaves that custody unchanged.
Waiver neither repairs the pre-existing deficit nor forgives another debt.
A wrong address, owner or mint is a binding failure, never unavailability.

fields.name: supplier_net
docs: Collection credit after the accepted Tab fee, before a separate approved
sponsorship debit. The exact sponsorship token legs are recorded below.

fields.name: debit_principal
docs: Actual ordinary-cash funding identity and token debit, independent of
the company whose obligation was serviced or the transaction fee payer.

fields.name: previous_creditor
docs: Immutable title/destination used by repayment, or the resulting title
after an assignment. Original supplier entitlement remains on the claim.

fields.name: cash_received
docs: Cumulative authenticated cash flows, not an automatically complete NAV.

fields.name: capital_allocated
docs: Explicit own-capital allocation, separate from income and token inflows.

fields.name: supplier_committed
docs: Supplier assets, distinct from an issuer's unused/payable liabilities
when the same continuing principal holds more than one economic role.

fields.name: accounted_cash
docs: Explicit allocation only. An unsolicited transfer does not become income.

fields.name: withdrawn_cash
docs: Cumulative authorized uncommitted debits: withdrawals, sends and swap input.
Includes eligible earned cash; it is not a valuation or income measure.

fields.name: usage_namespace
docs: Accepted completed-run price preimage, available directly to readers.

fields.name: seller_fee_agreement
docs: Immutable parent allocation. Accepted servicing never consults the parent.

fields.name: principal_extinguished
docs: Append-only v2 extension. Captured principal and cash history never rewind.

fields.name: corrections
docs: Original delivery, gross collection and principal repayments remain historical.

types.name: InterestRefundReceipt
docs: Immutable detail for the two independently approved cash legs. This sidecar
keeps the existing financial journal layout and gross-income fields intact.

fields.name: seconds_per_year
docs: Explicit year basis; no implicit production APR or spread policy.

fields.name: stop_on_shortfall
docs: The cash runtime rejects this until it authenticates historical shortfall
windows. Today's balance cannot establish yesterday's eligible duration.

fields.name: source
docs: Exact admitted funding source for this first issuer-backed profile.

fields.name: kind
docs: 1: person, 2: company, 3: other recognized principal.

fields.name: owner
docs: This first profile has one Ed25519 owner. Other governance profiles
require distinct handlers and cannot be selected by this field.

fields.name: extinguished
docs: Only legally/economically extinguishing, authenticated corrections.

types.name: RepaymentRefundRecord
docs: Principal and both interest refund capacities share one original repayment
identity. A later interest-refund handler must use this same usage account.

types.name: RepaymentRefundUsage
docs: Cumulative cash returned against one authenticated original repayment.
Principal, lender interest and protocol interest have separate beneficiaries
and refund capacities. Collected interest and historical repayments remain
gross facts; refunds never restore a paid debt or expenditure authority.

fields.name: aggregate_cap
docs: Immutable lifetime ceiling, in this asset's base units.

fields.name: approved_by
docs: Opening provenance, not the authority required for later reconciliation.

types.name: SellerFeeCapUsage
docs: Parent agreement allowance, distinct from buyer-financing FeeCapUsage.
Allocations are lifetime authorizations; settlement/refund never refills it.

fields.name: refunded
docs: Economic refund and voluntary fee credit are distinct returned-cash facts.

fields.name: fixed_fee
docs: Applied once to cumulative settlement, never once per run or retry.

fields.name: maximum_deduction_bps
docs: Cumulative upper slope; each settlement's maximum rounds UP by at most
one token base unit, while the total fee rounds DOWN cumulatively.

fields.name: conversion_numerator
docs: Approved conversion into the bound token's base units per lamport.

fields.name: expected_revision
docs: Optimistic concurrency guard, excluded from the stable business identity.
Exact retries retrieve the prior result even after the claim advances.
